name: Translation reminder on publish
description: Logs a reminder when a translatable parent transitions to status=published, prompting the editor to verify fr and es translation rows.

name: Publish site
description: Manual Publish: one build per editing session. Reads the public site version, POSTs the existing environment Vercel hook once, waits 10 minutes, then notifies the editor of the observed public version change. Each request has separate context; overlapping builds cannot be attributed to a particular press. No scheduled polling.

options.confirmationDescription: Publish site: rebuild the website from the current published CMS content. A CMS notification checks whether the public site changed about 10 minutes later.

name: Validate metric proof sources
description: Blocks invalid named metric sources before service or project-metric saves. Returns the original payload unchanged.
